name: Bipartite Graph with Transitive Theta Relation
statement: A connected graph $G$ belongs to the class exactly when $G$ is bipartite and the Djoković–Winkler relation $\Theta$ on $E(G)$ is transitive.
hypotheses: Connected graph. For edges $xy$ and $uv$, the relation is defined by $xy\mathrel{\Theta}uv$ when $d_G(x,u)+d_G(y,v)\ne d_G(x,v)+d_G(y,u)$.
comments: This criterion is intrinsic: it does not assume a chosen hypercube embedding.
